overview: Galsen Gaming is a modern dark-themed gaming e-commerce storefront with a full product catalog, product detail pages, and a working cart and checkout flow.
features: Browse a rich home page with hero, categories, popular products, promo, reviews and FAQ
Shop all products with category filters, price and popularity sorting, and search
Open detailed product pages with image gallery, specs, reviews and similar products
Add items to a persistent cart, adjust quantities and remove products
Complete a clear demo checkout with delivery form and order confirmation
Fully responsive experience with a mobile hamburger menu
